dimensions.assessment: Affects federal agencies, research universities, and laboratories owning or operating vessels in the U.S. Academic Research Fleet, as well as scientists, educators, and students.
dimensions.evidence: head of any Federal agency, university, or laboratory that owns or operates a vessel of the U.S. Academic Research Fleet

dimensions.assessment: Requires comprehensive assessments and a spending plan for equipment, software, and personnel upgrades across fleet vessels.
dimensions.evidence: an assessment of the costs necessary to meet the needs described in paragraphs (1) and (2)

dimensions.assessment: Directs the creation of a spending plan involving the National Science Foundation, the Office of Naval Research, and nonfederal owners, though specific spending amounts are not prescribed in the bill text.
dimensions.evidence: a spending plan for the National Science Foundation, the Office of Naval Research, non-Federal owners... and users

dimensions.assessment: Mandates specific planning duties and statutory reporting requirements for federal agencies regarding vessel cybersecurity and telecommunications.
dimensions.evidence: submit to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation of the Senate and the Committee on Science, Space, and Technology of the House of Representatives a plan

dimensions.assessment: Involves a one-time reporting requirement due within one year of enactment, with ongoing implications tied to the resulting spending and upgrade plans.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 1 year after the date of enactment of this Act, the Director shall... submit... a plan

missing_information: Specific funding amounts authorized or appropriated for the upgrades
importance_detail.rationale: The bill mandates the National Science Foundation to develop a plan addressing cybersecurity and telecommunications for the U.S. Academic Research Fleet within one year, directing coordination across federal agencies, universities, and laboratories.
